turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.

I understand. Since you disagree with the decision on your claim, I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over from here. If you have your order number, please send it so they can find the claim faster.

input.summary: Customer says staff already closed their damage claim, saying the pale patches are part of the drawing. Customer rejects that decision. No order number or email given yet. A colleague should review the closed claim.
